label: Euthyphro dilemma coverage has identity, exemplar and omission models (inference)
rule: explicit finite interpretations and general structural lemmas
meaning: Identity model: all identity premises and approval-only dependence hold, distinctness fails and neither horn holds. Exemplar model: distinctness holds, approval-only dependence fails, neither horn holds. Non-simple model: goodness is God's nature, which is not God and does not depend on him, so horn 1 holds. Voluntarist model: distinctness and approval-only dependence hold and horn 2 holds. Contingent-nature model: identity in each profile without a necessary nature lets goodness vary; generally identity with a necessary nature fixes it. Property model: God is his goodness, which is not the shared universal property; generally collapse into a property needs that identification.
